sdl3.notes: SDL 3.4.16 for iOS 27 UIScene lifecycle (B11). SDL_image remains 3.2.4. Local patch (re-apply on bumps): src/video/cocoa/SDL_cocoakeyboard.m unmarkText returns early when nothing is being composed, so the macOS Pinyin IME no longer swallows backspace. src/video/uikit/SDL_uikitviewcontroller.m textFieldTextDidChange: sends the UITextField marked text as SDL_EVENT_TEXT_EDITING (caret and length in UTF-32 characters, like Cocoa) and an empty TEXT_EDITING when the composition ends, before any committed text; resetTextState clears it too (sendMarkedText, hasMarkedText). src/camera/SDL_camera.c: SDL_LockCameraUnlessShutdown (new; declared in src/camera/SDL_syscamera.h); SDL_CameraThreadIterate holds the device lock for the whole frame and marks a failure lost under it, only on backends with ProvidesOwnCallbackThread (CoreMedia, Android, Emscripten), while MediaFoundation, V4L2, PipeWire and dummy keep the upstream locking; DestroyCameraHashItem keeps the device struct and its lock on own-callback backends (intentional leak, about 0.5 KB per destroyed device); lock order on the callback path is device lock then device-hash write lock, so never lock an open device while holding the hash lock; ClosePhysicalCamera resets device->props to 0. src/camera/coremedia/SDL_camera_coremedia.m: captureOutput: takes device and a strong hidden in one @synchronized section and compares hidden under the device lock (safe: the strong reference prevents address reuse); permission and zoom run under the device lock; COREMEDIA_AcquireFrame skips a missing sample; COREMEDIA_CloseDevice clears delegate.device first; callbacks are kept out by the device lock taken in ClosePhysicalCamera, not by CloseDevice; plus the frame-rate and zoom patches in docs/COREMEDIA_CAMERA.md. src/camera/android/SDL_camera_android.c (not compiled locally): onImageAvailable (reader check), onDisconnected and onError lock with SDL_LockCameraUnlessShutdown; Emscripten takes the same path, not compiled. Re-apply all of these when bumping SDL; see docs/COREMEDIA_CAMERA.md.
